metrics.name: Total Assets Under Management (AUM)
metrics.description: Total disbursed amount of all currently active and non-performing loans across both HFC and Finserve entities.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active', 'npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active', 'npa') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Disbursements
metrics.description: Aggregate amount of capital disbursed to borrowers since inception.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Gross NPA (GNPA) %
metrics.description: Percentage of the active portfolio that is non-performing (90+ DPD or Stage 3).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN stage = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active', 'npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, gnpa_pct AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Collection Efficiency %
metrics.description: Ratio of total EMI amount collected versus total EMI amount due in a given period.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(amount_paid) / NULLIF(SUM(amount_due), 0) AS value FROM collections_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, collection_efficiency / 100.0 AS value FROM monthly_collections ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Portfolio Yield
metrics.description: The weighted average annual interest rate across the active loan portfolio.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(interest_rate * disbursed_amount) / SUM(disbursed_amount) / 100.0 AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status IN ('active', 'npa')
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, avg_yield / 100.0 AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Cost of Funds
metrics.description: Weighted average cost of borrowings from banks, NHB, and other debt sources.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(interest_rate * outstanding_amount_cr) / SUM(outstanding_amount_cr) / 100.0 AS value FROM funding_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, weighted_avg_cost / 100.0 AS value FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', start_date) as month, SUM(interest_rate * outstanding_amount_cr)/SUM(outstanding_amount_cr) as weighted_avg_cost FROM funding_full GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Bounce Rate %
metrics.description: Percentage of EMI presentations that failed (bounced) on first presentation.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN bounce = true THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM collections_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, bounce_rate / 100.0 AS value FROM monthly_collections ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average Ticket Size
metrics.description: The mean disbursed amount per loan across the portfolio.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, avg_ticket_size AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Average LTV Ratio
metrics.description: Mean Loan-to-Value ratio across the portfolio, indicating collateral coverage.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(ltv_ratio) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, avg_ltv AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: New-to-Credit (NTC) %
metrics.description: Percentage of loans disbursed to customers with no prior credit history (Bureau Score = 0).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN is_ntc = true THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_ntc = true THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Provision Coverage Ratio (Stage 3)
metrics.description: The ratio of provisions held against non-performing (Stage 3) loans.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT pcr_stage_3 / 100.0 AS value FROM ecl_provisions WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM ecl_provisions)
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(month AS DATE) AS date, pcr_stage_3 / 100.0 AS value FROM ecl_provisions ORDER BY date

metrics.name: HFC Disbursement Mix %
metrics.description: Percentage of total disbursements contributed by the Housing Finance entity.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN entity = 'hfc' THEN disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(CASE WHEN entity = 'hfc' THEN disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Self-Employed Borrower Mix %
metrics.description: Share of borrowers that are self-employed (formal or informal), which is Vastu's core segment.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN employment_type LIKE 'self_employed%' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(CASE WHEN employment_type LIKE 'self_employed%' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: DSA Sourcing %
metrics.description: Percentage of loans sourced via Direct Selling Agents (DSA) vs other channels.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT dsa_sourced_pct / 100.0 AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis WHERE month = (SELECT MAX(month) FROM monthly_company_kpis)
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, dsa_sourced_pct / 100.0 AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Active Loan Count
metrics.description: The number of unique loans that are currently in 'active' status.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(loan_id) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE loan_status = 'active'
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT month AS date, active_loans AS value FROM monthly_company_kpis ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Total Assigned AUM
metrics.description: Total value of loans sold/assigned to other banks or financial institutions (Direct Assignment).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(amount_assigned_cr) * 10000000 AS value FROM assignment_summary
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT transaction_date AS date, amount_assigned_cr * 10000000 AS value FROM assignment_summary ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Co-Lending AUM
metrics.description: AUM originated specifically under co-lending arrangements with partners (Finserve).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(aum) AS value FROM co_lending_performance
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(disbursed_amount) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE co_lending_partner != '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Net NPA Addition
metrics.description: The net increase in NPA stock (Additions - Upgradations - Recoveries - Write-offs).
metrics.valueSql: SELECT (SUM(additions_cr) - SUM(upgradations_cr) - SUM(recoveries_cr) - SUM(write_offs_cr)) * 10000000 AS value FROM npa_quarterly_movement
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(substring(quarter, 1, 4) || '-' || (CASE WHEN quarter LIKE '%Q1%' THEN '04-01' WHEN quarter LIKE '%Q2%' THEN '07-01' WHEN quarter LIKE '%Q3%' THEN '10-01' ELSE '01-01' END) AS DATE) AS date, (additions_cr - upgradations_cr - recoveries_cr - write_offs_cr) * 10000000 AS value FROM npa_quarterly_movement ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Avg Loan Holding Period (Months)
metrics.description: Average duration for which loans were held on books before being assigned/sold.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(amount_assigned_cr * wtd_avg_holding_period_months) / SUM(amount_assigned_cr) AS value FROM assignment_summary
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT transaction_date AS date, wtd_avg_holding_period_months AS value FROM assignment_summary ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Stage 2 Exposure %
metrics.description: Portfolio percentage classified as Stage 2 (61-90 DPD), an early indicator of stress.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT stage_2_pct / 100.0 AS value FROM stage_distribution WHERE cohort_month = (SELECT MAX(cohort_month) FROM stage_distribution)
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(cohort_month || '-01' AS DATE) AS date, stage_2_pct / 100.0 AS value FROM stage_distribution ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Avg CIBIL Score
metrics.description: Mean CIBIL score for borrowers who are not New-to-Credit.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(bureau_score) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE bureau_score > 0
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, AVG(bureau_score) AS value FROM loans_full WHERE bureau_score > 0 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Annual Employee OpEx
metrics.description: Total estimated annual CTC of the workforce currently active.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT SUM(total_annual_ctc_lakh) / 100.0 AS value FROM branches_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', open_date) AS DATE) AS date, SUM(total_annual_ctc_lakh) / 100.0 AS value FROM branches_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Female Employee %
metrics.description: Percentage of the workforce identifying as female.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT female_pct / 100.0 AS value FROM employee_summary WHERE entity = 'hfc' LIMIT 1
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', join_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(CASE WHEN gender = 'female' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS value FROM raw_employees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Active Branch Count
metrics.description: Total number of physical branch locations currently operational.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM raw_branches WHERE is_active = true
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', open_date) AS DATE) AS date, COUNT(*) AS value FROM raw_branches WHERE is_active = true GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date

metrics.name: Avg Borrower Monthly Income
metrics.description: The mean monthly income of borrowers across the portfolio.
metrics.valueSql: SELECT AVG(monthly_income_inr) AS value FROM loans_full
metrics.timeSeriesSql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', disbursement_date) AS DATE) AS date, AVG(monthly_income_inr) AS value FROM loans_full GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY date
